text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: The lack of prenatal care and immunization records is concerning. Are there any visible skin lesions, rashes, or signs of infection such as jaundice or respiratory distress on physical examination?

text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a continuous heart murmur, non-blanching bluish macules, cataracts, and hearing loss is highly suggestive of congenital rubella syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Rubella_IgM_Antibody_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: The positive Rubella IgM test confirms the diagnosis. DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
